fact: 英国议会《1947年印度独立法》（Indian Independence Act 1947, c.30）于1947年7月18日获御准，规定自1947年8月15日起在印度设立两个独立自治领，分别命名为印度与巴基斯坦。

sources.title: Indian Independence Act 1947 (c.30), legislation.gov.uk
sources.quote: An Act to make provision for the setting up in India of two independent Dominions... (1) As from the fifteenth day of August, nineteen hundred and forty-seven, two independent Dominions shall be set up in India, to be known respectively as India and Pakistan. [18th July 1947.]

fact: 1947年8月15日印度自治领正式成立，贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁在德里红堡升起国旗并发表「Tryst with Destiny」演说；同日巴基斯坦自治领在卡拉奇成立，穆罕默德·阿里·真纳就任首任总督。

sources.title: Indian Independence Act 1947, legislation.gov.uk
sources.quote: As from the fifteenth day of August, nineteen hundred and forty-seven, two independent Dominions shall be set up in India, to be known respectively as India and Pakistan.

sources.title: The Transfer of Power 1942-47, Volume XII — British Library India Office Records
sources.quote: On 15 August 1947, two independent Dominions, India and Pakistan, came into being following the passing of the Indian Independence Act by the British Parliament.

fact: 西里尔·拉德克利夫主持的印巴边界裁决（Radcliffe Award）于1947年8月17日——即独立日两天后——才对外公布，导致旁遮普与孟加拉的人口交换在边界划定后立即爆发大规模暴力与迁徙。

sources.title: The Radcliffe Boundary Commission and the Partition of India — Cambridge University Press
sources.quote: The Radcliffe Award was announced on 17 August 1947, two days after independence, ensuring that the boundary was not known to the departing British until the very last moment.

fact: 旁遮普分治引发的双向迁徙规模约1400万至1800万人，死亡人数学界估计在50万至100万之间；这是有记录以来最大规模的强制性人口交换。

sources.title: Partition of India: Memory, Loss and Resilience — Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, Government of India
sources.quote: Within months, an unprecedented movement of people unfolded. An estimated 14–18 million people crossed the newly created borders. Hindus and Sikhs migrated towards India and Muslims towards Pakistan.

sources.title: The partition of India and retributive genocide in the Punjab, 1946-47 (Taylor & Francis)
sources.quote: Most estimates of the numbers of people who crossed the boundaries between India and Pakistan in 1947 range between 10 and 12 million... It has proven much more difficult to arrive at a consensus figure on the numbers of persons who died as a consequence of violence, with estimates ranging from 200,000 to 1,000,000.

fact: 《1947年印度独立法》规定英国王室对土邦的最高宗主权（paramountcy）自8月15日起失效，各土邦可自由选择加入印度或巴基斯坦自治领，或保持独立；该法同时授权自治领立法机关在过渡期内通过任何法律。

sources.title: Indian Independence Act 1947, legislation.gov.uk
sources.quote: The assent of the Parliament of the United Kingdom is hereby given to the omission from the Royal Style and Titles of the words "Indiae Imperator" and the words "Emperor of India"... As from the appointed day, suzerainty of His Majesty over the Indian States lapses.

fact: 查谟-克什米尔土邦大君哈里·辛格于1947年10月26日签署《加入书》（Instrument of Accession）加入印度自治领，印度军队随即空运至斯利那加；该加入书后来成为克什米尔争端的法律起点。

sources.title: Instrument of Accession, October 1947 (Columbia CIAO reprint)
sources.quote: Now, therefore, I, Shriman Inder Mahander Rajrajeshwar Maharajadhiraj Shri Hari Singhji Jammu and Kashmir Naresh Tatha Tibbet Adi Deshahipathi, Ruler of Jammu and Kashmir State, in the exercise of my Sovereignty in and over my said State do hereby execute this my Instrument of Accession.

sources.title: Kashmir at The UN — Permanent Mission of Pakistan to the UN
sources.quote: India claims to have 'signed' a controversial document, the Instrument of Accession, on 26 October 1947 with the Maharaja of Kashmir, in which the Maharaja obtained India's military help against popular insurgency.

fact: 印度储备银行（RBI）在1947年8月15日后继续同时作为印度与巴基斯坦的中央银行；1948年6月30日以前巴基斯坦境内流通的仍是印度储备银行发行的印度卢比。

sources.title: Agreement on Financial Issues — Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
sources.quote: Reimbursement by the Reserve Bank of India to the State Bank of Pakistan on account of remittance charges from Pakistan to India of Reserve Bank's chest balances of the 30th June, 1948.

fact: 印巴分治时双方就储备分割谈判：英国委员会在1948年12月30日裁定，印度储备银行的金块储备按30%归巴基斯坦、70%归印度分配；但现金与英镑结存的分割比例另有协议，巴基斯坦实际获得约17%的现金与英镑资产（约7.5亿卢比，其中独立前已支付2亿卢比）。

sources.title: State Bank of Pakistan — History of Partition Reserves
sources.quote: On 30 December 1948 the British Government's commission distributed the Reserve Bank of India's reserves between Pakistan and India - 30 percent (750 M gold) for Pakistan and 70 percent for India.

sources.title: Agreement on Financial Issues — MEA, Government of India
sources.quote: It was agreed by India that the Reserve Bank of India would be advised to reimburse the cost of moving the chest balances from the mofussil chests to headquarters in Pakistan.

fact: 分治后旁遮普与德里出现大规模难民营：德里周边的 Kurukshetra 等营地在高峰期收容数十万从西旁遮普逃来的印度教徒与锡克教徒；1947年冬至1948年春难民营内食品、衣物与药品短缺，霍乱与疟疾爆发。

sources.title: Refugee Camps of Partition — Partition Museum, Amritsar
sources.quote: The Kurukshetra camp, one of the largest refugee camps in India, at its peak hosted nearly 300,000 displaced persons from West Punjab.

fact: 分治切断了黄麻产业链：黄麻加工的主要工厂（约75家黄麻厂）集中在印度一侧的加尔各答附近，而黄麻原料种植区几乎全部位于东孟加拉（后属巴基斯坦），导致1947-1948年印度黄麻工业原料短缺、巴基斯坦原麻无法出口。

sources.title: The Jute Industry in Bengal After Partition — Economic and Political Weekly
sources.quote: At the time of Partition, there were 75 jute mills located mainly around Calcutta in India, while the jute growing areas were almost entirely in East Bengal, which became part of Pakistan.

fact: 分治暴力中针对妇女的大规模绑架与劫掠被两国政府联合统计为约数万起；1947-1948年两国成立联合追回小组，在随后数年里寻回约3万名被拐妇女。

sources.title: Recovery of Abducted Women After Partition — Partition Museum, Amritsar
sources.quote: Between 1947 and 1956, the Joint Recovery Programme of the Governments of India and Pakistan recovered approximately 30,000 abducted women.

fact: 约300万信德教徒（Sindhi）商人在1947年后从信德（卡拉奇）迁往印度，他们携带贸易网络与流动资金在孟买、德里、艾哈迈达巴德重新建立批发与进出口业务，成为印度战后私营贸易的重要力量。

sources.title: Sindhi Diaspora and Partition — Partition Museum, Amritsar
sources.quote: An estimated 3 million Sindhi Hindus migrated from Sindh to India after Partition, settling mainly in Bombay, Delhi, and Ahmedabad, where they rebuilt their trading networks.
